name: How do plumbers diagnose sewer line issues?

mainEntity.name: How do plumbers diagnose sewer line issues?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plumbers typically diagnose sewer line issues using a sewer camera inspection. This involves inserting a high-resolution, waterproof camera attached to a flexible rod into your sewer line. The camera transmits live video footage to a monitor, allowing the technician to identify blockages, cracks, root intrusion, misaligned pipes, or other damage. This method provides a clear, non-invasive way to pinpoint the exact location and nature of the problem without extensive digging.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plumbers diagnose sewer line issues by performing a sewer camera inspection, which uses a high-resolution camera to identify blockages or damage.
